audit.why: 55.31% over 179 games, difficulty 6/10, carry threat 7/10. Quinn owns levels 1-5 outright against a melee-range farming Neeko; Pop Blossom is the one button that flips it. EVEN with a 6/10 is a fair read of a lane you win by not getting stunned.
audit.corrected: Rating, diff and tone left as-is; the reasoning text now names the abilities the packet flagged as never mentioned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Skill, Quinn, Quinn in both layers; the packet and the audited mirror read Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Neeko, Skill, Quinn.
audit.why: The page's own whys already argue the packet version — whys[0] and whys[3] describe Quinn winning, whys[4] calls level 6 Neeko's spike, whys[5] explicitly says first item trades evenly. Four rows contradicted their own explanations.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 5 re-proposed as one atomic group in both layers, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer says to 'blind his Tangle-Barbs' — Blinding Assault cannot stop a spell. It also never states the interaction that actually beats her: Vault briefly interrupts its target, which is the answer to Pop Blossom's preparation. And Neeko is called 'he' throughout.
audit.why: Riot text for Vault: 'she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it'. Pop Blossom has 'a short preparation' that is hidden while she is disguised, on 120/105/90s. Tangle-Barbs is a 1000-range root on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s that grows larger, faster and longer-rooting after passing through a champion. Behind Enemy Lines is a channel any CC cancels — Inherent Glamour, Tangle-Barbs and Pop Blossom all qualify.
audit.corrected: Blind restated as a nearsight against autos only. Vault's interrupt named as the counter to Pop Blossom and given its 675 range / 12s. Tangle-Barbs given its cooldown and its through-champion upgrade. Channel-cancel warning added. Pronouns fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer mentions W-clone disguise but the full layer never does; nor does either mention that the R preparation animation is hidden while disguised.
audit.why: That hidden preparation is why Pop Blossom kills people — there is no visible wind-up to react to, so the answer has to be pre-held Vault and W's reveal, not reaction.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You convert into plates with the shove and W's attack speed. She has no kill pressure until Pop Blossom, so take the tempo now.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Pop Blossom is an AoE stun whose preparation is hidden under a W clone disguise — Vault's interrupt answers it, and her root cancels your channel.

edits.after: Youmuu's trades evenly with her first AP item. A clean Tangle-Barbs dodge, not the item, decides the skirmish.
